correctness.rationale: Eight signed box vertex heights ±S,±d_1,±d_2,±d_3 classify generic plane-edge sign crossing counts: for small nonzero t a pentagon occurs exactly when one of three |d_i|<|t|; at most two strips overlap and no triple does. In positive spherical octant density 2/pi, coarea shows each strip area (2 L_i/R)t+O(t^3) and the three great-circle arc lengths satisfy sum L_i=pi. Near each two-strip boundary crossing, local triangular set |delta|+a_k w<t has area t²/(a_k sqrt(a_i²+a_j²))+O(t³). Inclusion–exclusion sum E_i-2 sum pair intersections gives exactly leading 4t/R and displayed quadratic term; symmetry gives |t|. Strict convexity of [v(1-v)]^-1/2 for v_i=a_i²/R² and Jensen yield unique cube and coefficient -18sqrt(2)/(pi R²). Independent second coefficient numerical checks for 3 box shapes corroborate strict Jensen bound, not analytic proof.
